name: Setar (droid)
description: Setar was a droid who was part of the Second Revelation, a group of sentient droids. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Setar was present in the Colony of the Second Revelation and offered a piece of plating to the group's leader, Ajax Sigma, which was to be installed onto a new droid to join their number. Sigma accepted the gift, stating it would suit.
